what.value: One machine-written ticket per observed War Machine self-heal repair occurrence: reproduce/verify the observed failure at a named pipeline stage and correct or restore it.
what.quote: Reproduce the reported behaviour at the named stage and correct its cause.

varies.value: All eight share the template and OPEN status; they differ in failure kind (binding mismatch, resume violation, abstain, agent unavailable, guardrail refusal, transport timeout, falsifier failure), stage (:author-wait, :cascade-resume, :selection, :agent-readiness, :construction, :reviewer-wait), target (M-war-machine-wiring, M-autoclock-in, M-descriptive-essay-of-the-stack, M-self-documenting-stack, or not retained), and scoped-task flavor (correct vs verify-or-restore). One class.

action.quote: Verify the reported precondition and restore it if it remains unavailable.

finish.value: Each ticket DONE when its scoped repair/precondition-check evidence is accepted through ordinary ticket review.
finish.quote: mark this ticket DONE only when its scoped work is accepted
